data.title: 诀 · 深夜静室玄黑真丝依偎
data.action: 斜倚深色丝绒卧榻轻解纱袍系带望来
data.lighting: 低照度暖红屏风灯与窗畔微冷月影
data.description: 屏风后那盏暖灯只亮着一寸柔光。卸去所有护甲的李织烟斜倚在深色卧榻边，玄黑朱边真丝内衣贴合着清瘦而修长的腰身，外罩的玄黑薄纱长袍半敞着滑落臂弯。她指尖轻搭在丝带结上，清冷双眸此刻深得几乎要将人吸进去——「门已经闩好了。今晚不必再谈任务。」
data.promptProse: Reclining across dark silk bedding in the dim amber glow of a quiet chamber, Arcane wears obsidian silk lingerie trimmed in crimson beneath an open sheer black robe, looking directly at the viewer with heavy-lidded poise.
data.animaCaption: She reclines on dark silk bedding with her sheer black robe falling open off her arms, holding the viewer's gaze with quiet intensity.
